SUBCHAPTER V. PROTECTIVE ZONING AND ENFORCEMENT

3 M.S.C. 1 § 1501ZONING STRATEGY. Members of Law Enforcement who are conducting or helping in the act of protections may establish a protective zone which is reasonably sized around a protectee. No individual who is not an individual authorized by a law enforcement officer engaged in conducting protections may enter a protective zone.REPEALED
90
3 M.S.C. 1 § 1502No protective zone shall be established in advance on private property without consent from its owner or custodian. If within the confines of a publicly owned building and/or publicly owned property, the protective zone shall extend to the entirety of the building or property, and the reasonable area surrounding such building or property. If within the confines of a privately owned building, the protective zone shall extend the entire size of a reasonable area designated by the State Police (which shall not be larger than one hundred (100) square studs) and a reasonable radius around any doors, entryways, or exits. No individual who is not an individual authorized by a law enforcement officer engaged in conducting protections may enter a protective zone.REPEALED
